old_data_audit.ruling: old test frames are development/historical regression only; no longer independent sealed test

data_collection.gui: foreground visible Isaac Sim GUI, DirectX/D3D12, no headless/hidden

cases.source: new config reverse of A south
cases.reason: direction/approach differs from old south route

data_collection.sample_rule: route accepted RGB records: every 20th sequence plus the last 12 accepted frames (fixed before labels/evaluation); static: all accepted RGB frames. No selection by detector score or result.

labeling.amounting: manual agent labels, aided by pixel inspection for bbox/reference point; not user expert review; no detector output used to create labels
labeling.target: RMUC2027 RoboMaster central tower; natural map structure
labeling.unreliable: mark UNKNOWN/NOT_ANNOTATABLE and exclude from localization TP but retain in denominator

acceptance_proposed.bearing_definition: angle from camera optical axis to manually labelled green roof-light reference point; camera intrinsic fx; not world bearing
acceptance_proposed.localization_tp: bbox IoU>=0.3 and reference point error<=5 deg
acceptance_proposed.metrics: presence TP/FP/FN/TN; localization TP/FP/FN; precision/recall; IoU/ref point/bearing error; UNKNOWN/REJECTED; stratified by view/scale/occlusion/negative/family; frame and trajectory

algorithm.baseline: old single tower template v1, threshold 0.55, bbox-center bearing (presence-only baseline)
algorithm.improvement_1: multi-view template library from development only (center/left/near route), max NCC
algorithm.improvement_2: template anchor reference point (green roof light) for bearing; geometry/aspect validation; no threshold-only recall tuning

time_semantics.capture: SIM_UPDATE_SAMPLE_TIME; exposure UNKNOWN; age not full latency

expected.new_test_may_fail: algorithm effect may be below PROPOSED thresholds; report honestly

data_collection.localization_label_subset: route positive windows: first, middle and last sampled positive frame; static: all accepted positive frames. Bbox/ref-point labels only on this predeclared subset; presence labels on all sampled frames.

revision_reason: v1 fixed every-10th route sampling; after looking only at target visibility (not detector outputs), the target appears only in the final approach window. v2 adds a predeclared trailing window; v1 is preserved as pilot/historical.

expected.sampling_limitation: small independent sample; report exact denominators and do not claim statistical adequacy
expected.old_result_revision: old 36-frame test set was based on same south route family for train and two reset test episodes; old recall 0.5 is presence-level only and not an independent localization result
